messages:
elena: Heads-up runtime team: were finalizing a launch webinar and need a tiny, reproducible bench bundle for marketing (heatmap + simple CSV).

matt: What model/config and matrix?

elena: redwood/3b-compat-v1. Compare fp16 and int8-quant. Batch 1 & 8, concurrency 1 & 16. Seqlens: 32, 192, 1024. Percentiles per-request (50/95/99).

sophie: Include tokens/sec and $/1k tokens calculation inputs and any warmup notes. Well publish one slide + short caveats.

andy: Plan: 2 warmups, 150 samples per cell, capture 50/95/99, GPU util, and stderr for kernel warnings. Well upload artifacts (CSV, traces, env.txt).

elena: Sample prompts: https://gist.example.com/redwood/webinar-samples (use "webinar-clean").

matt: Ill capture commit hash, CUDA/driver, kernel selection. If int8 is flaky at long context, call it out.

sophie: Deadline Thu 18:00 PT for artifact bundle (CSV + normalized chart + one PNG).

andy: Repro block well attach:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-compat-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":64,"batch":1}'
```
